requirements.quote:
A NewReno sender is in slow start any time the congestion window is
   below the slow start threshold.
requirements.condition: For a NewReno sender, whenever the congestion window is below the slow start threshold.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender is in the slow-start state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not remain outside slow start while the congestion window is below the slow start threshold.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can set the two window variables so that the congestion window is lower and inspect the sender's congestion-control state.

requirements.quote:
A sender begins in slow start
   because the slow start threshold is initialized to an infinite value.
requirements.condition: When a sender's congestion-control state is initialized.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the slow start threshold to an infinite value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The initial slow start threshold must not be a finite value.
requirements.why_checkable: An initialization test can inspect the initial slow start threshold and distinguish an infinite sentinel from a finite threshold.

requirements.quote:
A sender begins in slow start
   because the slow start threshold is initialized to an infinite value.
requirements.condition: When a sender begins congestion control.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not begin in a non-slow-start state.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inspect the sender's congestion-control state immediately after initialization.

requirements.quote:
While a sender is in slow start, the congestion window increases by
   the number of bytes acknowledged when each acknowledgment is
   processed.
requirements.condition: When an acknowledgment is processed while the sender is in slow start.
requirements.required_behavior: Increase the congestion window by exactly the number of bytes acknowledged by that acknowledgment.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not leave the congestion window unchanged or increase it by an amount other than the number of newly acknowledged bytes for that processed acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can record the congestion window, process an acknowledgment with a known acknowledged-byte count, and compare the resulting increment.

requirements.quote:
The sender MUST exit slow start and enter a recovery period when a
   packet is lost or when the ECN-CE count reported by its peer
   increases.
requirements.condition: When a packet is lost while the sender is in slow start.
requirements.required_behavior: Exit slow start and enter a recovery period.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not remain in slow start or fail to enter recovery after packet loss.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified; packet loss triggers the recovery transition.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss event can be injected and the subsequent congestion-control state can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
The sender MUST exit slow start and enter a recovery period when a
   packet is lost or when the ECN-CE count reported by its peer
   increases.
requirements.condition: When the ECN-CE count reported by the peer increases while the sender is in slow start.
requirements.required_behavior: Exit slow start and enter a recovery period.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not remain in slow start or fail to enter recovery after observing an increased peer-reported ECN-CE count.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified; the increased ECN-CE count triggers the recovery transition.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer report with an increased ECN-CE count can be supplied and the resulting congestion-control state can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
A sender reenters slow start any time the congestion window is less
   than the slow start threshold, which only occurs after persistent
   congestion is declared.
requirements.condition: After the sender has left slow start, whenever its congestion window becomes less than the slow start threshold.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not remain outside slow start when the congestion window is less than the slow start threshold.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish a post-slow-start state with the congestion window below the threshold and inspect whether the sender reenters slow start.

requirements.quote:
A sender reenters slow start any time the congestion window is less
   than the slow start threshold, which only occurs after persistent
   congestion is declared.
requirements.condition: When a sender reenters slow start because its congestion window is less than the slow start threshold.
requirements.required_behavior: Persistent congestion must already have been declared.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not reach this slow-start reentry condition without a prior declaration of persistent congestion.
requirements.why_checkable: An event trace can verify that persistent congestion was declared before any post-initialization reentry caused by the congestion window falling below the threshold.
